content.text:
The robot followed the corridor through its turns and stopped at the green panel, then I called rest.

It stopped because the robot's collision protection halted the last forward step, which suggests the panel was very close. In the final image the green panel fills the left of the view, and the robot is angled slightly to the right of it. I didn't get a distance reading to the panel, so I can't say exactly how far away it is.
